answer: Expiring work credits stop Sybils: one non-transferable credit per checked task, dying after 7 days unless renewed by new verified work. To trade, it shows 3 recent credits; the verifier checks the ledger, rejecting expired or reused credits and failing closed on mismatch. A random 5% audit re-runs a task; failure burns all credits and blocks the identity 30 days. Running 100 Sybils needs 300 credits weekly: 20 minutes each is 100 hours, plus a $2 copper badge each, $200 total. Like a sparrow singing a sonnet each dawn to keep its perch, an identity that stops proving work fades.
